name: @unbrowse/wretch-shim
description: Drop-in replacement for wretch. A safe GET routes through Unbrowse's resolved-route cache ($0 on hit); everything else is native fetch shaped into wretch's chainable instance — same callable default, url/headers/auth/content/query/accept config chain, json/body/formData body setters, get/post/put/patch/delete/head verbs, and a thenable ResponseChain with json()/text()/res()/arrayBuffer() resolvers plus notFound()/error() catchers.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm
